header.description: The continuation frame, read where the model said the row's own text. `said` is a word this checkpoint does say in its first six tokens for two of these rows and does not for the other two — the weights are random, so what it says is gibberish and the column was written to match it; on a real model `said` would be the answer. `at_said` is {'frame': 'generated', 'index': -1, 'scope': {'variable': 'said'}}: the last token of that word in what this row generated. Whether the model said it at all is a reported result — two rows score and two come back `alignment_missing` — rather than an exception that ends the run. `at_stop` asks where the row stopped; the step holds EOS off (`min_new_tokens` is its bound), so no row stops and every row says so.
